headline.sentence: leave-family-out, 8468 species-dereplicated reference genomes (median per fold at density 1.0), coverage 0.856: prfba_nestedcv population EC-F1 0.626 vs picrust2 0.7494, delta -0.1235 (95% CI [-0.1499, -0.0991], cluster bootstrap over 171 holdout groups, n_eff 598); skill score vs constant/clade-max floor-ceiling -0.1403; SESOI 0.02 exceeded.
